title: Skull Ridge Mountain Hotelier
description: A lair hidden deep in the heart of Skull Ridge Mountain on the planet of Lanupa contained the secret treasure stash of the legendary pirate Tak Rennod. Full of treasures from around the galaxy, it was also rigged with traps and held the coordinates to At Attin. Forgotten over the years, no one knew it was there when a luxury spa for the wealthy was built on the mountain.
